	["AIC Heavy Armor"]={name="AIC Heavy Armor", id="item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_body_01", tier=2, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers heavy protection. \nAfter attaching thicker and heavier armor plates onto the suit, the armor would likely end up at places where it becomes the target of powerful guns.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["AIC Heavy Plate"]={name="AIC Heavy Plate", id="item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_01", tier=2, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers heavy protection. \nRaising defense performance also leads to massive increases in weight, which also happens to be the biggest issue with this equipment.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["AIC Alloy Plate"]={name="AIC Alloy Plate", id="item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_02", tier=2, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers heavy protection. \nThough extremely cheap to manufacture, it offers an acceptable degree of protection thanks to the quality materials used.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["AIC Gauntlets"]={name="AIC Gauntlets", id="item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_hand_01", tier=2, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers heavy protection. \nJust two intricate supporting structures are used to help bear 40% of weaponry weight. This is smart design.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["AIC Light Armor"]={name="AIC Light Armor", id="item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_body_01", tier=2, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers light protection. \nIt was a byproduct created during a test run of several mixed production lines involving various AIC Factory facilities.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["AIC Light Plate"]={name="AIC Light Plate", id="item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_edc_01", tier=2, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers light protection. \nThe biggest feature of this AIC gear is that it allows armor plates to be flexibly attached to the suit.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["AIC Ceramic Plate"]={name="AIC Ceramic Plate", id="item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_edc_02", tier=2, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. 	["Roving MSGR Jacket"]={name="Roving MSGR Jacket", id="item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_body_01", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A jacket that any messenger would love to wear. \nMessengers working in and near the Valley IV region will often give their vehicles paintjobs with tree-like patterns. They hope the sight of these majestic plants that once protected this land can bring people strength.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Roving MSGR Gyro"]={name="Roving MSGR Gyro", id="item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_edc_01", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="An intricate fidget toy. \nResults from a trustworthy poll revealed that about 20% of messengers have modified this stress-relief toy into a self-orienting tracker.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Roving MSGR Flashlight"]={name="Roving MSGR Flashlight", id="item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_edc_02", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A sturdy hand-held electric lamp. \nThe sharp spike on the other end can also be used to break open old boxes or containers.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Roving MSGR Fists"]={name="Roving MSGR Fists", id="item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_hand_01", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A pair of gloves that messengers love to use. \nMessengers would also pass their time by fighting in the arena.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Armored MSGR Jacket"]={name="Armored MSGR Jacket", id="item_equip_t2_suit_str01_body_01", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A jacket that any messenger would love to wear. \nScramblers are cheap and effective modes of transport on Talos-II. Messengers would often outfit these bikes with different mods and modules.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Armored MSGR Gyro"]={name="Armored MSGR Gyro", id="item_equip_t2_suit_str01_edc_01", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="An intricate fidget toy. \nResults from a trustworthy poll revealed that about 80% of messengers would modify this toy into a miniature dart grenade.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Armored MSGR Flashlight"]={name="Armored MSGR Flashlight", id="item_equip_t2_suit_str01_edc_02", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A sturdy hand-held electric lamp. \nThe sharp spike on the other end can also be used to break the bones of those who refuse to talk.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Armored MSGR Gloves"]={name="Armored MSGR Gloves", id="item_equip_t2_suit_str01_hand_01", tier=3, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A pair of gloves that any messenger would love to wear. \nMost messengers would install easy-to-use lifesaving ejection systems on their vehicles to contend with unexpected Blight ruptures.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Resistant Vest"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Vest", id="item_equip_t2_suit_will01_body_01", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A sturdy, protective vest. \n\"PPE must be properly worn in emergency repair sites. Failure to do so might make you see damaged facilities and machinery calling out to you for help... Just stop giving our surgeons extra work, okay?\"", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Resistant Wrench"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Wrench", id="item_equip_t2_suit_will01_edc_01", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="An elegantly designed wrench with smooth outlines. \n\"Pretty handy for bonking heads!\" — A worker who wished to remain anonymous", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Resistant Battery"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Battery", id="item_equip_t2_suit_will01_edc_02", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="These batteries are pretty heavy. \nAn experienced worker can transform this Originium battery into an improvised grenade within 10 minutes.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Resistant Gloves"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Gloves", id="item_equip_t2_suit_will01_hand_01", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A pair of very sturdy gloves. \nWe have yet to develop PPE suits with true Blight resistance. Most PPE and protective solutions in service could only cope with secondary disasters of Blight events.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Insulation Vest"]={name="Mordvolt Insulation Vest", id="item_equip_t2_suit_wisd01_body_01", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A piece of equipment essential for special environment operations. \nSevere Blight events often cause anomalous electrical and circuitry failures. Workers assigned to repair work must watch out for them.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Insulation Wrench"]={name="Mordvolt Insulation Wrench", id="item_equip_t2_suit_wisd01_edc_01", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A wrench with special protective coating. \nThis can also be used as a weapon when necessary. It is fully capable of crushing and pulverizing Aggelos limbs.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Insulation Wrench T1"]={name="Mordvolt Insulation Wrench T1", id="item_equip_t2_suit_wisd01_edc_02", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. 	["Mordvolt Insulation Battery"]={name="Mordvolt Insulation Battery", id="item_equip_t2_suit_wisd01_edc_03", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="An extremely durable battery. \nIn Talos-II, emergency repair work in Blighted conditions is an extremely dangerous job. Hence, workers must undergo strict training based on special standards before they are allowed to use batteries in such environments.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Insulation Gloves"]={name="Mordvolt Insulation Gloves", id="item_equip_t2_suit_wisd01_hand_01", tier=3, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A piece of equipment essential for special environment operations. \nAll engineers making electrical repairs at Blight rupture sites must wear specialized PPE to avoid injuries caused by anomalous bursts of electrical discharge.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},

	["Aburrey Heavy Armor"]={name="Aburrey Heavy Armor", id="item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_01", tier=4, use="Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. \nExcavation of Precursor relics can be a rather convoluted process filled with unexpected changes. Equipment used during excavation must offer sufficient protection, dexterity, as well as offensive capabilities.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Aburrey Heavy Armor T1"]={name="Aburrey Heavy Armor T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_02", tier=4, use="Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. \nA combat model of the Aburrey Heavy Armor. When compared to the standard model, this suit features additional weapon connection ports highly compatible with flamethrowers, grenade launchers, and other ordnance.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Aburrey Light Armor"]={name="Aburrey Light Armor", id="item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_03", tier=4, use="Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. 	["Aburrey Light Armor T1"]={name="Aburrey Light Armor T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_04", tier=4, use="Designed by Triglava Armoury and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="Novel protective equipment modified to suit the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. \nThe engineers worked through the night to slap on mods when work at Aburrey Quarry suddenly involved excavation and digging. 	["Armored MSGR Jacket T1"]={name="Armored MSGR Jacket T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_str01_body_01", tier=4, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. 	["Armored MSGR Gyro T1"]={name="Armored MSGR Gyro T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_str01_edc_01", tier=4, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. 	["Mordvolt Resistant Vest T1"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Vest T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_will01_body_01", tier=4, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="A sturdy, protective vest. \n\"PPE must be properly worn in emergency repair sites. 	["Mordvolt Resistant Battery T1"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Battery T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_will01_edc_01", tier=4, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.", desc="These batteries are pretty heavy. \nAn experienced worker can transform this Originium battery into an improvised grenade within 10 minutes.", obtain="Gear Assembly"},
	["Mordvolt Resistant Wrench T1"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Wrench T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_will01_edc_02", tier=4, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. 	["Mordvolt Resistant Gloves T1"]={name="Mordvolt Resistant Gloves T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_will01_hand_01", tier=4, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. 	["Mordvolt Insulation Vest T1"]={name="Mordvolt Insulation Vest T1", id="item_equip_t3_suit_wisd01_body_01", tier=4, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. 	["Mordvolt Insulation Vest T2"]={name="Mordvolt Insulation Vest T2", id="item_equip_t3_suit_wisd01_body_02", tier=4, use="Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. 	["Qingbo Light Armor"]={name="Qingbo Light Armor", id="item_equip_t4_suit_combo_cd01_body_02", tier=5, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory. 	["Qingbo Positioning Kit"]={name="Qingbo Positioning Kit", id="item_equip_t4_suit_combo_cd01_edc_01", tier=5, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory. 	["Qingbo Bamboo Cutter"]={name="Qingbo Bamboo Cutter", id="item_equip_t4_suit_combo_cd01_edc_02", tier=5, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory. 	["Qingbo Cask"]={name="Qingbo Cask", id="item_equip_t4_suit_combo_cd01_edc_03", tier=5, use="Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory.
